caption: Bright feel-good pop instrumental for a short social video, 120 BPM, major key, warm and friendly. Soft felt piano chords, warm round bass, marimba melody, gentle live drums with a soft kick and brushed snare, airy pad. A simple four-chord progression that repeats every four bars the whole way through. Steady groove from the first bar to the end, no intro, no breakdown. No hi-hats, no cymbals, no ticking, no glitches. Smooth polished production, soft rounded high end. Instrumental, no vocals.
lyrics:
[Verse - steady groove from the first beat, soft piano chords, marimba melody]

[Chorus - a little brighter, warm pad]

[Verse - steady groove, new melody]

[Chorus - brighter]
